description: Source code for a ZIP extraction utility using yauzl, implementing an Extractor class with methods to extract ZIP entries, handle symlinks, directories, and manage extraction options.

classes.name: Extractor
classes.description: Class responsible for extracting ZIP files, handling entries, directories, symlinks, and applying extraction options.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Opens the ZIP file and processes each entry, handling errors and completion.

methods.name: extractEntry
methods.description: Extracts individual ZIP entries, creating directories, files, or symlinks as needed.

methods.name: getExtractedMode
methods.description: Determines the file mode for extracted entries based on ZIP entry attributes and options.
